mentions.name: trentdb
mentions.description: In-process, single-node database query engine inspired by DuckDB, written in Java, with support for running all TPC-H queries. Built primarily as a learning project to understand databases in depth.
mentions.problem: Serves as a personal project to understand databases in depth.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on trentdb . An in process single node database query engine inspired heavily by duckdb . Its primarily for me to understand databases in depth . Its completely written by codex and in java . Why Java? Its the language I am most familiar with  . I just finished adding support for running all TPC-H queries.
